title: Integrality criterion for a monomial
statement: Let $k$ be a field, $P$ a submonoid of an abelian group $G$, and $g\in G$. In the group algebra $k[G]$, the monomial $e^g$ is integral over the subalgebra $k[P]$ if and only if there exists an integer $n>0$ with $ng\in P$. Consequently, for every such $P$, the subalgebra $k[P^{\mathrm{sat}}]$ is integral over $k[P]$, since it is spanned by monomials integral over $k[P]$. We use the monoid and group-completion conventions of [def-trf-fine-fan-blowup].
